as_told.title: Wilbert Smith top secret memo: flying saucers classified two points higher than the H-bomb

plain: The story is about a top secret memo written in 1950 for the Canadian government by a Canadian official named Wilbert Smith, which is said to report that the US was hiding flying saucers. A researcher named Steven Greer tells Michels the memo is "top secret from the Canadian government" and that he thinks it "accidentally got declassified." Greer says he put it in a briefing document of his own. A researcher named Grant Cameron gives its content: according to the memo, flying saucers exist and are "the most highly classified subject in the United States," rated "two points higher than the H-bomb." Cameron names others tied to the memo, the American scientist Vannevar Bush and two more men, Robert Sarbacher and Omond Solandt. If true, a friendly government's own records would show that in 1950 the US treated flying saucers as its highest secret.
